integrity: Exact finite 4096-state enumeration by two separately coded graph representations and algorithms, with explicit relabelling, source, and a symbolic all-family lemma; no third-party full text embedded.
scientific_limitations: Full attraction-basin and sharp entrance-time classification is finite and limited to the labelled Dürer graph GP(6,2). The symbolic isolated-polarization lemma extends to every simple cubic GP(n,k) in the stated range. Previous recurrent-state counts are explicitly credited and are not claimed novel. The exhaustive programs are replayable but lack independent external validation; unindexed historical basin tables may exist.
title: An exact Dürer majority basin spectrum with two dynamically isolated layer equilibria
